assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: A5 editorial field-guide chapter-opener illustration, printed about 108 mm wide
Input images: Image 1 is the governing style reference only; preserve its engraving density, monochrome ink treatment, three-quarter perspective, technical object realism, contrast, and generous white-space behavior. Do not reproduce its machine or composition literally.
Primary request: Create an original visual metaphor for 'draw the safety boundary.' Show one coherent mechanical field-inspection instrument: an intact generic wild mushroom specimen rests on a small specimen tray before a precise optical inspection gate, while a substantial closed barrier mechanism on the far side makes the stop boundary unmistakable. The apparatus should imply careful observation and comparison before any decision, not mushroom identification.
Scene/backdrop: pure opaque white paper with no horizon or environment
Subject: one integrated inspection apparatus and one intact generic mushroom specimen; no humans
Style/medium: meticulous nineteenth-century scientific engraving in black ink, stippling and fine cross-hatching, richly rendered mechanical detail, visually consistent with Image 1
Composition/framing: centered single-object composition in three-quarter perspective, calm editorial scale, generous crop-safe white margins on all sides, complete silhouette, no element cut off
Color palette: black ink only on pure white
Constraints: illustration only; no text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, arrows, icons, logos, borders, frames, watermarks, UI, color, gray paper, transparency, or drop shadow; no recognizable edible or poisonous species; do not imply that the apparatus can certify edibility
Avoid: vector schematic, flowchart, infographic, cartoon, generic clip art, photorealistic photograph, decorative botanical plate, skulls, hazard symbols, dramatic horror imagery
assets.selectionRationale: The closed physical barrier communicates a hard stop while the optical instrument and intact specimen preserve the evidence-chain mental model. The result matches the canonical engraving treatment without becoming a labeled diagram.
